options.title: Larry Ellison pledged {fact1} Oracle shares to borrow money 🏦
options.first_line: Larry Ellison has pledged {fact1} Oracle shares, just to borrow money.
options.first_frame: A bank counter: a billionaire in a suit with a gold name plate 'LARRY ELLISON' slides a towering stack of Oracle share certificates across, and the banker's stamp is coming down on it.

options.title: Oracle's founder borrows instead of selling: {fact1} shares pledged
options.first_line: Larry Ellison, who started Oracle, borrows against his shares instead of selling them.
options.first_frame: Outside a bank vault, a suited figure labelled 'LARRY ELLISON' hands a stack of Oracle share certificates to a banker who hands back a bag of cash.

options.title: Larry Ellison's Oracle salary was {fact5}. He borrows against {fact1} shares
options.first_line: Larry Ellison took a {fact5} salary from Oracle, and borrowed against {fact1} of his shares.
options.first_frame: An Oracle pay slip reading the one-dollar salary pinned beside a towering stack of share certificates with a bank's padlock on it.

why: A famous name with a one-dollar salary set against a mountain of pledged shares makes a stranger ask how a billionaire lives on nothing, and the pay slip beside the padlocked stack tells that contrast even with the sound off.
